Taiwan warned the world about COVID. China lied, silenced doctors, and let the virus spread.

This week, for the 10th straight year, the UN’s global health body excluded Taiwan because Beijing demanded it.

Taiwan told the truth. China covered it up. The UN rewards China anyway.

“We must obey God rather than men.” — Acts 5:29

Pastor Jin’s courage is a reminder that faith cannot be dictated by the Communist Party. When governments demand loyalty above God, standing firm has a cost — and that’s exactly why the pastor’s witness matters.

This week, we are praying for his release and for all those wrongfully detained, persecuted, and imprisoned for their faith in China.


The Free Press (@TheFP)

On October 10, 2025, Chinese authorities launched coordinated nationwide raid

Xi’s message at the US-China summit was simple: stay out of Taiwan. That’s not diplomacy. It’s a threat.

Taiwan is what Xi cares about most — more than tariffs, markets, or any deal.

The Chinese Communist Party doesn’t get to dictate American foreign policy.

Claiming Israel trains dogs to rape Palestinians is modern day blood libel — propaganda pushed as more horrific details emerge about Hamas’ systematic torture on Oct. 7.

For being Jewish — Hamas raped a woman and burnt half of her face off in front of her husband; shoved nails, metal, and sharp objects into Israeli women; forced family members to sexually assault each other so that if they survived they would be traumatized by the sight of each other; raped corpses; the list goes on.

Distracti

If the Chinese Communist Party is this brazen with congressional staff, imagine what’s happening in boardrooms, universities, and defense contractors. 

This is everywhere.


Select Committee on China (@ChinaSelect)

A would-be spy offered a staffer on @ChinaSelect $10,000 for insider information on U.S. policy.

Our staffer's response? Report it, document it, and expose it. As a Select Committee, we referred the matter to the @FBI after documenting the outreach and collecting call transcripts.

A huge thank you to @wis10 and @JudiGatson for helping us celebrate 10 incredible years of the @Original6Found’s after-school programs!

What started with 150 students in a handful of rural South Carolina communities has grown into something big-- impacting more than 1,000 students across 13 counties this year alone. 

But, we're just getting started! Next school year, we want to help even more young people build confidence, develop leadership skills, succeed academically, and reach their full p

A Christian pastor has been imprisoned in China since October. He committed no crime. He was jailed for worshiping God. Trump is right to raise his case with Xi. The contrast couldn't be starker: one nation guarantees the freedom to worship, the other jails you for it.


Julia Manchester (@JuliaManch)

NEW: President Trump told me he will bring up the imprisonment of Christian Pastor Ezra Jin to Chinese President Xi during his trip to Beijing next week. 

“I’ll bring it up,” he said.

Jin has be

What happened at the University of Michigan is bigger than one speaker and it deserves more than an apology.

It’s well known Michigan has a large Jewish student body. The administration knew the speaker’s record and still handed him the mic—leaving those students isolated and targeted.

Protests on campus have repeatedly crossed the line: encampments, disrupted ceremonies, demonstrations at officials’ homes, clashes with police.

The first amendment must be protected but it doesn’t absolve anyo

An amazing @GeorgeStrait concert last night! What a way to start with @codyjohnson and the crowd singing God Bless America in Death Valley. @clemsonuniversity

Video

Strong move. 

China has been quietly bankrolling Iran’s terror network through massive oil purchases and backdoor trade for years.


U.S. State Dept - Near Eastern Affairs (@StateDept_NEA)

U.S. Sanctions Tighten Grip on Iran-China Oil Trade
state.gov/releases/office-of…




— https://nitter.net/StateDept_NEA/status/2050274845473075635#m

America just crossed a dangerous milestone: our national debt now exceeds the size of our economy. Washington spends $1.33 for every $1 it takes in, with a $1.9T deficit this year alone. When the bill comes due, expect higher taxes, a weaker dollar, fewer services, a weaker military—and our kids stuck paying for it.

As Iran keeps stalling, Treasury is right to sanction the dozens of entities helping keep the regime’s oil profits flowing. Keep the pressure on and squeeze their revenue until they come to the table. And it’s time to go after the Chinese banks, too.


Treasury Department (@USTreasury)

Today, as part of Economic Fury, Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control designated 35 entities and individuals that oversee Iran’s shadow banking architecture and facilitate the movement of the equivalent of

China gave the world COVID. Then the Chinese Communist Party directed hackers to steal American COVID research while we were fighting the pandemic.

Yesterday, one of those hackers was extradited to the U.S. to face charges. He’s also linked to a Chinese state-backed group that compromised nearly 13,000 U.S. organizations.

This is one arrest, but China has thousands of hackers on its payroll. Worth remembering as we’re negotiating deals with the same government that did this.
Amazing to see King Charles unify Congress in a way America craves. Great speech on our historic relationship, our democratic values, and our belief in freedom. 🇺🇸🇬🇧

China steals what it can’t build — fighter jet designs, cancer drug formulas, and now AI. If we don’t make them pay for that theft, we risk handing the Chinese Communist Party the most powerful technology edge in history.

We shouldn’t give our tech away either. Selling China our most advanced chips only helps them win.

Businesses should thrive or fail on their own merits—not through government picking winners and losers.

No bailouts, period!

The ship the U.S. seized in the Strait of Hormuz this weekend was headed from China to Iran and is linked to chemical shipments for missiles. 

It refused repeated orders to stop. 

Another reminder that China is helping prop up Iran’s regime—a reality that can’t be ignored.

We need to make sure Iran is no longer a national security threat to the United States. This is how we make it happen.
